preconditions.expression: isinstance(m, str) and all(c in {'#', '_'} for c in m)
preconditions.description: Input string m consists only of '#' (filled) and '_' (empty) characters.
Length of m (n) is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout.split() and stdout.split()[0].isdigit() and all(part.isdigit() for part in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or a valid profile (non-negative integers) on two lines: first line is k (number of integers), second line is k space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (lambda: any(mask_to_profile(m) == p for p in possible_profiles(m)))()
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', then the output profile p' is a valid profile that matches the mask m (i.e., all filled cells in p' are exactly those in m).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (lambda: all(profile_to_mask(p) == m for p in [stdout.split()[1:]] if stdout != '-1'))()
postconditions.description: If stdout is not '-1', then the mask derived from the output profile p' is exactly m.
